newsitem.title: USA: U.S. congratulates French left on election victory.
newsitem.headline: U.S. congratulates French left on election victory.

text.p: The United States congratulated France's Socialist Party and its allies on their victory in Sunday's parliamentary election and said it expected to maintain close ties with the new government.
"The United States congratulates the Socialist Party and its allies on their clear victory," said State Department spokeswoman Julie Reside.
"We look forward to the naming of the new prime minister and cabinet. As always, we welcome the opportunity to continue our close cooperation with France," she said.
Reside said U.S. relations with France had always been excellent and she expected them to remain close and cooperative under the new left-wing government.

French government sources said Prime Minister Alain Juppe would tender his resignation to President Jacques Chirac on Monday morning following Sunday's election defeat; Socialist leader Lionel Jospin should be appointed to succeed him immediately.
